sentences.text:
Opposite   ------
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH -----

For the Petitioner: M/s. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate For the State : M/s. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P For the Informant: M/s. Vikash Kumar, Advocate ---
09/10.02.2025

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Ulidih P.S. Case No. 198/2023, registered under Sections 406/ 420/ 506/ 120B of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Sri Alok Kumar, learned J.M.F.C, Jamshedpur.

On 02.02.2023, the petitioner is alleged to have taken Rs.2,17,000/- from the son of the informant,
on the promise that his money will be doubled.
Learned lawyer for the petitioner submitted that he is handing over draft of rupees one lakh to the learned lawyer for the informant subject to the final disposal of this case.
Learned lawyer for the informant, accepts the draft in the court.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case and considering the fact that the petitioner had made part payment of the money which was handed over to him by the son of the informant, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction Vivek Kumar Tiwary vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
